newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo mulls removing Nomura from bond underwriting.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo mulls removing Nomura from bond underwriting.

text.p: The Tokyo Metropolitan government is considering removing Nomura Securities Co Ltd from its bond underwriting, an official for the metropolitan government said on Wednesday.

An official with the metropolitan government's bond section said it is considering the move due to the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission's (SESC) decision on Tuesday to file complaints against Nomura with prosecutors.
"Although no official decision has been reached yet, we are now considering removing Nomura from the underwriting of (the Tokyo metropolitan government's) bonds," the official said.

Nomura is likely to be taken off underwriting the Tokyo metropolitan government's bonds at least until administrative punishment against the brokerage proposed by the SESC takes place, the official said.
The SESC complained to prosecutors on Tuesday that Nomura Securities, Japan's biggest brokerage, and three former executives made illegal to payments to a client.
